## About

This repository documents the procedures used to test the `databraryr` R package.

## Set-up

Install the package from GitHub.

```r
remotes::install_github(repo = "NYU-Databrary/databraryr", ref = "development")
```

::: {.callout-important}
Note that I am testing from the `development` branch.
:::
